KNITWEAR & LAYERS
121
STUDY 156
Gray Ribbed Hoodie & Studded Flares
Rights check
Source: 25071.jpg
Edgy, structured, Y2K
WORKING NOTES
- The studded flares and straps are the defining details.
- Add 'full-length, head to toe' to keep the shoes in frame.
Try this: Use head-to-toe framing to include the shoes.
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long,
straight dark hair stands full-length
against a white backdrop. She wears a
fitted gray ribbed zip hoodie with a
V-neck and flap pockets, with small
star-shaped metal accents at the waist.
Black flared trousers have rows of silver
eyelets and long straps down the legs,
with a fur-trimmed pouch at one hip. Her
expression is calm and direct. Soft, even
studio light. Palette of heathered gray,
black, and silver. Edgy and structured, in
the style of a Y2K streetwear lookbook.
